szoveg_eredeti:
Attackers have agents now. Defenders need them too.

In July, the Hugging Face Hub got hit by a swarm of frontier agents and we discovered the challenge of defending yourself manually.

So we built Nightwatch, a security agent that watches an organization's activity on the Hub in real time: from access tokens usage to private repos creation, analyzing visibility changes and logins from new places in the world, every signal that may indicate something is happening.

When something looks off, it immediately investigates and messages your security team on Slack with detailed story and actions like: "A token created a year ago just read 60 of your private repos from two unknown IPs. 4 were cloned. We revoked it."

We've been running it on our own infrastructure for several weeks, and it has already flagged a zero-day exploit attempt in the wild on a third party library.

Today we're making it available to any Enterprise org on the Hugging Face hub as an add-on. It burns a lot of tokens, from open and closed models, so you don't have to :)

Check it out here: https://lnkd.in/d7qaUpYP
